newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products weak, but fuel oil resists trend.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products weak, but fuel oil resists trend.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Friday, but fuel oil resisted the decline, dealers said.

Premium unleaded gasoline barges shed $4.00 per tonne to trade at $221 for first half loading, and regular unleaded maintained a $6 discount. One trader expected this differential to widen since the U.S. market was very weak.
IPE November gas oil slipped $5.00 to $214.00 per tonne, but physical was quiet due to a German holiday. Heating oil barges held a notional $1.00 premium fob ARA.
But fuel oil was the exception, hardly losing any of its value despite crude's $1.00 per barrel fall.
